newsitem.title: CHILE: D&P rates Enersis Yankee bonds A-minus.
newsitem.headline: D&P rates Enersis Yankee bonds A-minus.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it has assigned an A-minus rating to Chilean power investment utility Enersis' $500 million Yankee bond offering.
Duff & Phelps said it based the classification on Enersis' sound business and financial fundamentals.
"(The company) benefits from a constructive regulatory environment, a strong local economy and conservative financial policies," said the statement.
Enersis will use proceeds from the debt offering mainly to repay bank loans used for investments in local generator Endesa and Argentine utility Edesur.
